title: Quasi-Banach spaces of random variables and stochastic processes
summary: This book develops the theory of quasi-Banach $K_σ$-spaces $\mathbf{F}_ψ(Ω)$, $\mathbf{F}_ψ^*(Ω)$, and $D_{V,W}(Ω)$ of random variables and stochastic processes, extending the classical framework of Orlicz spaces, $Sub_\varphi(Ω)$ and $V(\varphi,ψ)$ spaces. The book consists of eleven chapters. The first two chapters establish the foundational theory: stochastic processes from quasi-Banach $K_σ$-spaces are introduced, and the fundamental properties of $\mathbf{F}_ψ(Ω)$ are studied in detail.
